# NOTES: *When Oriole Traveled Westward* (Amy Bell Marlowe, 1921; sequel to *When Oriole Came to Harbor Light*)

## Main characters
- **Oriole Putnam**: girl from Bahia, Brazil; parents Mr. & Mrs. (Mamma) Putnam; father "Noddy"/"daddy" drowned; mother rescued by ship *Ellerton*. Lives with Mrs. Rebecca Joy, Dexter mansion, State St., Littleport (Mass.). Says "Dear me," "I declare." Loves Myron/Marian; calls mother "Sister" in play.
- **Myron & Marian Langdon**: 4-yr-old twins. Myron says "Mawyann" for Marian; Marian lisps "w" for "r". Children of **Harvey Langdon**, Montana ranchman (Three-bar Ranch; brand "Three-bar"; Langdon ranch ~Montana, Timmins Station, Hempdell shipping town).
- **Teddy Ford**: curly brown hair, pink-white complexion, says "Gee!" constantly (Oriole objects). Former ranch hand (corrals, 3 months); accused by Langdon of stealing family silver chest. Father a pocket hunter/prospector (died). Attended school in Helena. Good with rope and horses.
- **Nurse Sadie Brown** ("Brownie"): Western woman, twins' nurse; injured in Portland steamboat wreck; hit on head; memory returned. Scorns George Belden, later marries him.
- **George Belden**: trail foreman, lanky, blue eyes, humorous mouth; wants to marry Sadie.
- **Nat Jardin** (Uncle Nat): old lightkeeper, Harbor Light Island; rheumatism. **Ma Stafford**: housekeeper. Speak dialect ("cal'late," "Sho!").
- **Payton Orr**: substitute lightkeeper, gossip; wife and baby.
- **Lyddy Ann**: fleshy maid-of-all-work at Mrs. Joy's; fears ghosts; "piece of mind."
- **Mrs. Rebecca Joy**: sea-captain's widow.
- **Billy Bragg**: cabin boy, *Adrian Marple*; saved, went to Boston.
- **Ching Foo**: old Chinese cook at Three-bar; pidgin English ("Me no catchee pidgin"; "Melican boy look out"; "Three topside bad men"); coffin of lacquer stored in bedroom.
- **Sol Perkins**: ranch manager, Louisiana drawl.
- **Long Jim**, **Lenny** (puncher), **Shaffer** (Shaddy? no—Shaffer), **Hank (Tony) Ridley**, **Tom Mudd**: the three "bad men"; Ridley leader; Mudd and Shaffer captured.
- **Enos Crabbe** (storekeeper, town council president), **Shedder Crabbe** (son); ram **Jingo**.
- **May Rabey**, **Minnie & Flossy Payne** (Busy Bees society).
- **Anson Cope**: iceboat *Bluebird* that ran into girl on ice.
- **Mrs. Grimsby / Captain Nathan Grimsby** of the three-masted *Ellerton* (trading ship from Barnegat, NJ).
- **Molly**: Oriole's blue pony. **Blooey**: lazy pony pulling phaeton.

## BOOK I — Chapters in *When Oriole Traveled Westward* (as read here, one volume)
Ch I–XXX, in order:

1. **Ice adventure**: New Year's black frost, Littleport Harbor frozen; Government ice-breaker. Oriole pulls twins on sled toward Harbor Light Island (to supper with Nat Jardin & Ma). Myron: "hot cakes." Oriole calls Myron "eye-server" lesson. Anson Cope's iceboat *Bluebird* runs down sled; starboard runners break thin ice over Tide Flow; Oriole, sled, twins plunge. Marian lost under ice; Myron saved by Oriole.
2. **Teddy Ford** rescues: curly-haired boy dives, brings Marian up; hauls all out; "Oriole is a bird. Fly!" Teddy says he came from Paulmouth on Captain Diggers' boat. Oriole's backstory: Billy Bragg; *Helvetia* collided; *Adrian Marple* picked up Oriole; wreck on Camper Reef. Twins' Portland steamboat wreck; orphan asylum; advertisement.
3. **Strange actions**: Nat & Ma take them in. Teddy reveals hatred of Harvey Langdon, says he was accused of stealing silver; runs away. Nat notes Langdon's "Harvey Langdon, the ranchman."
4. **Oriole worried**: Payton Orr visits, gossips; Ma & Nat discuss Langdon. Floyd Ireson ballad joke.
5. **Night**: Langdon comes by iceboat, takes twins to Littleport Inn. Teddy returns at night, Oriole confronts him in kitchen; he admits being "bad" & says Langdon framed him.
6. **Teddy's story**: worked on Langdon's ranch 3 months; mother died; father prospector who went off; school in Helena; Ching Foo; "Three topside bad men": Ridley, Shaffer, Tom Mudd. Teddy leaves on boat to Boston.
7. **Other people's troubles**: Teddy says goodbye; Oriole tells Langdon about Teddy's rescue; Langdon says Teddy "a bad egg" but offers help. Langdon invites Oriole to Montana.
8. **Oriole's own troubles**: school; May Rabey, Shedder Crabbe; Busy Bees meeting at Paynes'; Shedder's ram Jingo crashes through conservatory window. Langdon tells Oriole her parents' fate: father drowned; mother maybe picked up by freighter.
9. **Great change coming**: Oriole weeps; Lyddy Ann "scare't" by sheet "ghost" at clothesline.
10. **Partings**: Enos Crabbe accuses Oriole of stealing Jingo; sheet/ghost chases Crabbe; Jingo butts Crabbe in street; Jingo made into mutton. Surprise party for Oriole. Myron's tar-paper speech. Departure Monday for West.
11. **New experiences**: Sadie Brown meets Oriole; train from Boston; horse-car beside train; sees Teddy in stock car; porter; train starts.
12. **Exciting times**: Oriole shouts to Teddy: "Are you coming too?" "I'll be there by the spring round-up." Trip via Chicago, Kansas City (George Belden, trail foreman). Teeman's Station, 40 miles from ranch.
13. **At the range camp**: mad Hereford cow overturns buckboard; Oriole jumps with twins; branding of calf with "running iron" (Three-bar brand). "Beds!" camp move.
14. **Ching Foo**: ranch house built in Indian times. Ching Foo cook; Oriole questions him about bad men; Belden says Ridley et al. "run out" of previous place; Ching: "Me no see."
15. **Molly**: Oriole rides blue pony Molly. Overhears Mudd & Shaffer/Ridley in scrub-oak ravine: "prospect hole," "Three Sisters," "Hank," "triumvirate," "old pit," "split the breeze." Belden: "Those are the Three Sisters."
16. **Spring round-up**: Blooey & phaeton; Ching's lunches. Oriole roping stump; yearling butts; stump lariat catch: captures Teddy Ford (hidden behind stump eating lunch).
17. **Bird of freedom**: Teddy & Oriole talk; Teddy went via Bowling Green, St. Louis, Kansas City; Billy Bragg alive, in Boston (news from sailor). Golden eagle swoops at Myron.
18. **A new deal**: Teddy ropes eagle; Langdon arrives on black stallion, releases eagle; Langdon apologizes to Teddy: "This is a new deal." Teddy given job with Sol Perkins.
19. **Exciting fishing party**: Teddy & Oriole discuss suspicions; plan to search Three Sisters basin. Squaw Canyon trip with Brownie, Belden, twins; Blooey, burro, Ching's food. Mysterious figure in side canyon.
20. **Bruin on the line**: Belden reports Ridley/Mudd/Shaffer have asked for pay. Brownie flirts with Belden at night. Horses ride up canyon: Hank Ridley & Mudd looking for Shaffer. Oriole catches trout; bear takes fly & line; Belden shoots bear.
21. **News of moment**: Bear skinned; Oriole believes Ridley & Mudd hunted Shaffer. Langdon returns: news that Mr. Putnam drowned and Mrs. Putnam maybe on sailing ship *Ellerton* (or *Edgerton*), Captain Nathan Grimsby, wife, Barnegat NJ. Langdon & Brownie decide not to tell Oriole yet.
22. **Something going on**: Oriole loves Langdon as father; 22 horses stolen from "Freeman's Sink" pocket; Sol Perkins vs. wrangler. Oriole rides to Squaw Canyon; finds campfire ashes; rope/shaft clue.
23. **Suspicion is rife**: Brownie & Belden plan to head off thieves; Brownie drives twins in phaeton with Teddy. Oriole rides alone into basin; sees posse fight horse thieves (Ridley & Mudd); overhears Ridley: Shaffer; rope hidden in shaft.
24. **The twins in trouble**: Ridley & Mudd kidnap twins off phaeton; Ridley snatches Brownie's pistol; Brownie's mustang bucks, she's thrown and twists ankle; Ridley demands Langdon call off men for four days. Oriole & Teddy pursue.
25. **Nature's wonders**: Oriole & Teddy follow up Byson's Creek to waterfall; see Myron screaming from far side, men climbing beyond fall; "fly over?"
26. **At close quarters**: Oriole finds hidden path behind waterfall; Teddy follows. Shaffer seen; Mudd & Shaffer fight; Ridley with pistol. Oriole rescues twins; "Take us home."
27. **The wrist watch**: Teddy protects; Ridley flees; Belden & posse capture Mudd & Shaffer. Secret of waterfall path kept. Oriole discovers her gold wrist-watch (gift from Myron at New Year's Eve) is lost.
28. **Shall Oriole be told?**: Langdon reads letter from Boston: *Ellerton* confirmed; Captain Nathan Grimsby; ship bound for South Seas; he & Brownie decide not to tell Oriole. Teddy & Oriole debate Langdon's suspicion.
29. **Of course!**: Oriole returns alone to basin to find watch; sees Ridley lower rope from bowlder into prospect shaft.
30. **The promise of the future**: Oriole unties rope; Ridley trapped in shaft; posse rescues Ridley; Teddy lowered and finds silver chest in horse-blanket; Teddy's name cleared; Langdon promises him a fair chance. Brownie marries Belden; twins and Teddy at wedding. Telegram from mother: "Leave by overland special to-day for the ranch. Meet me at Timmins Station.—Mother." Oriole to meet mother; Langdon promises another wrist-watch. END.

## Series notes
- Next volume named: "When Oriole Went to Boarding School" (mentioned).
- Book cover: author Amy Bell Marlowe; also: "When Oriole Came to Harbor Light" (prior volume); publisher Grosset & Dunlap, 1921.
